Name: Simple Item Lock
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Item Lock
[b]Keep your important items safe and exactly where you placed them.[/b]
Simple Item Lock protects selected items from sorting, automatic transfers, selling, shipping, trashing and crafting. A small gold lock shows which items are protected.
How to use
[list=1]
[*]Open your inventory or a supported chest menu.[/*]
[*]Hover over an item and press [b]F[/b] to lock it.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F[/b] again to unlock it.[/*]
[/list]You can change the binding through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Features
[list]
[*][b]Keep your layout:[/b] locked items stay in their exact backpack or chest slots when using Organize.[/*]
[*][b]Prevent accidental sales:[/b] protected items cannot be sold through the normal shop interface.[/*]
[*][b]Protect against trashing and shipping:[/b] keep valuable items out of the trash and shipping bin.[/*]
[*][b]Protect crafting ingredients:[/b] locked items are excluded from the game’s standard crafting ingredient checks.[/*]
[*][b]Skip automatic transfers:[/b] locked items are protected from supported bulk deposits, withdrawals and Fill Stacks.[/*]
[*][b]Prevent automatic stack merging:[/b] locked stacks stay separate during automatic inventory operations.[/*]
[*][b]Move items yourself:[/b] deliberate manual movement is still allowed, and the lock follows the item.[/*]
[*][b]Clear visual markers:[/b] a small gold lock identifies protected items.[/*]
[*][b]12 languages:[/b] follows the language selected in Stardew Valley.[/*]
[/list]Optional settings
With [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you can:
[list]
[*]Change the lock/unlock hotkey.[/*]
[*]Show or hide lock markers.[/*]
[*]Show or hide lock/unlock messages.[/*]
[/list]GMCM is optional. Settings can also be changed in
[code]config.json[/code]while the game is closed.
If another mod already uses [b]F[/b], choose a different binding.
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.4.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]SimpleItemLock[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Hover over an item and press [b]F[/b].[/*]
[/list]When updating, replace the mod files and keep your
[code]config.json[/code].
Compatibility
Simple Item Lock protects operations that use the game’s standard inventory, sorting and crafting methods. Custom storage, crafting or automation mods that bypass those methods may require separate compatibility support.
This is a standalone mod. Simple Tool Belt and Simple Pouch are not required.
Does locking stop me from moving an item?
No. Locking protects against automatic movement and supported destructive actions. You can still deliberately move the item to another slot or chest, and it remains locked.
How do I sell or use a locked item for crafting?
Hover over it and press your lock hotkey again to unlock it.
